metadata.title: AI Security Baseline
metadata.remarks: Tailored control set for AI security architecture work. Draws from NIST 800-53 Rev 5 (security and privacy controls), with future additions from NIST AI RMF and EU AI Act once those catalogs are hand-authored in Batch 1C-ii-c. This profile is a starting point; projects extend or replace per their needs.

resources.title: Selection rationale
resources.description: These 800-53 controls were selected as most directly applicable to AI security architecture work. Control families covered: Access Control (AC) for least-privilege agent capabilities; Audit and Accountability (AU) for AI action logging; Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring (CA) for continuous compliance; Configuration Management (CM) for AI system change control; Contingency Planning (CP) for circuit breakers; Identification and Authentication (IA) for agent identity; Incident Response (IR) for AI incident playbooks; Planning (PL) for spec-driven discipline; Risk Assessment (RA) for threat modeling; System and Services Acquisition (SA) for AI supply chain security; System and Information Integrity (SI) for AI integrity and monitoring; Supply Chain Risk Management (SR) for AI component provenance. Will be extended in Batch 1C-ii-c with references to NIST AI RMF subcategories and EU AI Act articles.
